title: FloatChat ARGO domain entities
description: Single source of truth for every ARGO domain type crossing the wire. frontend/types/argo.ts and backend/app/schemas/argo.py are GENERATED from this file - never hand-edit them. See contracts/README.md.

QCFlag.description: Normalized ARGO quality-control flag. Mirrors the GDAC 1-9 scale: 1 good, 2 probably good, 3 probably bad, 4 bad, 5 changed, 8 estimated, 9 missing.

AnomalySeverity.description: How loudly a detected anomaly should be surfaced.

DataMode.description: ARGO processing mode. 'real_time' is uncalibrated; 'adjusted' and 'delayed' carry scientifically validated values and are preferred when present.

AnomalyTag.description: A flagged condition on a measurement or profile. Always carries machine-readable evidence so the UI can explain WHY without knowing anything about the detector.

detected_by.description: Registry id of the detector that produced this tag.

evidence.description: Numeric facts supporting the flag, e.g. {"observed": 29.41, "threshold": 29.0}. Rendered generically by the UI.

ArgoFloatPoint.description: The atomic 4D measurement: one variable set, at one depth, at one time, from one float. The type the entire system revolves around.

wmo_id.description: WMO float identifier. A STRING, not an integer - leading zeros are significant.

cycle_number.description: Profile cycle index. Sourced from a float64 in NetCDF; cast explicitly.

longitude.description: Normalized to [-180, 180] by the provider. Note that equatorial Pacific floats cross the antimeridian.

depth_m.description: Metres below surface, POSITIVE DOWNWARD. Derived from pressure in the provider.

pressure_dbar.description: Original ARGO measurement in decibar, retained for scientific fidelity.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC with a Z suffix. Always.

temperature_c.description: Sea water temperature, degrees Celsius. null when missing - never -999 or NaN.

anomaly_tags.description: Empty array when nothing is flagged. Never null.

extras.description: EXTENSION SLOT. Biogeochemical and non-core variables (oxygen, chlorophyll, nitrate, pH) land here with NO schema change. The UI renders controls for them from the matching VariableDescriptor in /meta.

ProfileLevel.description: One depth bin within a single cast.

ProfileDerived.description: Diagnostics computed from a cast. Every field is nullable because a shallow or sparse cast may not support the calculation, and a fabricated value is worse than a null.

thermocline_depth_m.description: Depth of maximum negative temperature gradient.

mixed_layer_depth_m.description: Depth at which temperature departs from the near-surface reference by a fixed threshold.

surface_temperature_c.description: Shallowest valid temperature in the cast.

method.description: Names the algorithm used, so a future change is visible in the data rather than silent.

DepthProfile.description: A single cast: measurements against depth for one float at one cycle.

TrajectoryPoint.description: One surface fix on a float's path. Deliberately lighter than ArgoFloatPoint - a trajectory carries thousands of these.

GeoBBox.description: Geographic bounding box. When min_lon > max_lon the box WRAPS the antimeridian and must be evaluated as two OR-ed spans. This is a real case in the equatorial Pacific, not a hypothetical.

FloatTrajectory.description: One float's path over time, as time-ordered surface positions.

FloatSummary.description: Lightweight float record for pickers and lists. Never carries measurement arrays.

VariableDescriptor.description: Runtime metadata for one measurable variable. THE mechanism that lets the UI render controls, legends and axes for variables it was never coded against - add one here and the frontend adapts with no code change.

key.description: Field name on ArgoFloatPoint, or a key inside its extras map.

colormap.description: Names a perceptually-uniform scientific colormap in frontend/design/scales.ts. These are DATA, not brand - never adjusted for aesthetic fit.

is_extra.description: True when the value lives in the extras map rather than as a first-class field.
